game.title: San Francisco 49ers at Los Angeles Rams

lede: Los Angeles Rams carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#1 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Los Angeles Rams -5.9 with a fair total of 50.7 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.
